name: Underworld Crawler
description: A low-clearance tracked vehicle designed for Underworld traversal. Built from modified construction equipment or purpose-fabricated by Underworld communities, Crawlers handle the uneven terrain, tight passages, and zero-visibility conditions of the deep tunnels. Sealed cabin with air filtration, external lights powerful enough to illuminate caverns, and tracks that grip wet stone. Operating a Crawler in the Underworld is equal parts driving and spelunking. The machines accumulate damage — scratches, dents, strange residues — that tell the story of everywhere they've been.
propulsion: Electric tracked drive, sealed battery systems
speed: 20 km/h on smooth tunnel floor, 5 km/h in rough passages
tier_availability: Underworld communities, licensed explorers, Arcturus expeditions
cost: Φ15,000-30,000 depending on condition and provenance
autonomy: Manual operation, terrain mapping AI optional
armament: External lights (can be blinding), reinforced hull, ram plate. What operators carry personally varies.
common_usage: Underworld exploration, deep community transit, resource extraction, Arcturus-contracted expeditions.
story_hooks: A Crawler returns from a deep expedition with its hull covered in marks that look like something was trying to peel it open
The terrain mapping AI on a Crawler starts identifying biological signatures in the tunnel walls
related_entities: Novafold Pharmaceuticals GraftSkin TS-7 Bioprinted Dermal Replacement Sheet
physical_description: A squat, heavily armored tracked vehicle resembling a cross between a mining cart and a military transport, its welded steel hull scarred by years of tunnel navigation. The cabin sits high over twin caterpillar treads caked in mineral deposits and dark residue, with reinforced viewport shutters flanking a brutalist windscreen. Twin halogen rigs protrude from the chassis like insectoid eyes, their lenses fogged and yellowed from phosphorescent fungi and acidic runoff.
